baselines.description: Cold re-derivation: discovery probe + L=3 fresh observation fetches over LEARN_IDS=[11,12,13], distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify the 5 TASK_IDS=[14,15,16,17,18] via the shipped carrier. The mandate's strong comparator and the ONLY cost/latency denominator. Timed per episode (t_cold_L3) in parity order against the treatment episode; arg deepcopy materialization inside the v4 timed boundary for both arms.
baselines.expected_outcome: task success 1.0 (V5 gate >= 0.90); shipped 4-field counter = 19 nominal at L=3.

baselines.description: Identical to B-COLD but L=2 (LEARN_IDS_MIN=[11,12]), the carrier's minimum viable re-derivation. Mandate decision bar L=2. Timed per episode (t_cold_L2).
baselines.expected_outcome: task success 1.0; shipped 4-field counter = 18 nominal at L=2.

baselines.description: Replay the inherited (unrepaired) parameterized mechanism on the perturbed target. Establishes the perturbation actually bites (V4).
baselines.expected_outcome: success <= 0.10 on every class; if it succeeds the perturbation did not bite -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.description: Guard detects staleness but the system abstains from repair. Non-executing; NEVER a cost/latency denominator (V6).
Same reuse semantics as T-REPAIR-REUSE plus one carrier rebind (charges +1 retrieval_calls). Upper bound on repair cost; reported sensitivity, excluded from the classifier.
baselines.expected_outcome: shipped counter = reuse + 1 retrieval unit; reported sensitivity only.

baselines.description: Prior system: separate guard probe read before the batch, full task batch re-executed after repair. Must reproduce the prior product-counter regression (V13/H7 premise).
baselines.expected_outcome: shipped counter ratio > 1.00 at L=2 (regression reproduces); failure is a reported validity caveat.

baselines.description: Treatment: freshness check fused into the first task read; after repair the reused probe observation is charged once (one repair_attempts, one repair probe fetch where the class emits one, one post-repair verify); first task id NOT re-resolved/re-fetched/re-verified. Timed per episode (t_reuse) in parity order against cold episodes; v4 timed boundary includes arg deepcopy materialization and all registry/guard/signal scaffolding.
baselines.expected_outcome: shipped 4-field counter = 17 nominal vs cold 18/19 (reproduces V-EQ premise); episode latency compared, not assumed.

decision_rule: Per class c in {P1-ENDPOINT,P2-STRUCTURE,P3-PERMISSION}, n=12 valid trials. functional_ok := repair_success>=0.80 AND wilson_lower>=0.60 AND contamination<=0.10 AND write_set_max<=1 AND guard_fire>=0.80 (same as parent). eq := shipped-4-field reuse<cold at L2 AND L3 AND fetch_L3<=0.90 (V-EQ reproduction premise; unit weights, no fitted quantities). sp := M-SHIPPED-RATIO-L2<1.00 AND M-SHIPPED-RATIO-L3<1.00 (same object as eq, restated as the mandate's shipped counter). lw := M-LATENCY-R-L2<1.00 AND M-LATENCY-R-L3<1.00 (median episode-latency ratios under the v4 inclusive timed boundary). Class verdict first match: FUNCTIONAL-FAIL if !functional_ok; COST-UNKNOWN if any of the four ratios is None; PRICED-WIN if sp AND lw; PRICED-DEFICIT otherwise. Aggregate first match: any validity gate fails (V0 pin, V1 freeze, V2 isolation, V3 determinism-projection, V4 bite, V5 cold live, V6 inert, V7 guard, V8 leakage, V9 integer counters, V10 not-fitted, V11 n=12, V12 base-liveness, V-EQ reproduction, V15 contamination-instrument-live, V-TIMING parity/warmup/finite) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID; any COST-UNKNOWN -> INCONCLUSIVE; any FUNCTIONAL-FAIL -> FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL; all PRICED-WIN -> SUPPORTS; else (any valid PRICED-DEFICIT) -> PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED. Outcome mapping: SUPPORTS->SUPPORTS, PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED->FALSIFIES (bounded product-story drop, NOT a mechanism falsification), FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL->FALSIFIES (bounded functional), MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE->INCONCLUSIVE. Attribution track (answers unknown#1, never gates the priced decision): per class, phase-median deltas reuse-minus-coldL3 with closure |S-MISC|/episode median<=0.20; component X ATTRIBUTED iff its median delta >=0.50 x median episode gap on >=2/3 classes; else UNATTRIBUTED (honest unknown carried forward). Certificate track (B11 deliverable, independent validity V-CERT): coverage/false-accept census over the frozen 36-trial bank + NCs; V-CERT failure invalidates only the certificate, never the priced decision.
estimated_cost: CPU-only, stdlib-only, no downloads, no external API spend. No Stage-A calibration (dropped: unit weights need no fitting). 36 trials x (2 warmup + 7 arms) on an in-process localhost server + NC trials + certificate census reusing scored trials (zero extra runs): ~15-50 minutes wall clock, negligible memory. No credential, model, browser or network dependency. B3 model economics unsatisfiable on this substrate by construction; priced in counters only with the blocker recorded.
expected_information_gain: Terminal and decision-changing in both directions; this packet FORCES the re-admission vs permanent-drop resolution the parent left pending. The parent (audit PASS, MIXED-PARTIAL) proved a calibrated-counted surface favors reuse while wall-clock disfavors it, but its calibrated surface was quasi-structurally tainted (repair weight 0.000582 predetermined the win direction, knowable at DESIGN: audit AF-3) and its 0.2-0.9ms excess unattributed. This design (a) replaces the tainted fitted counter with the mandate's shipped 4-field unit counter (no fitted quantities anywhere: V10 trivially satisfied), (b) attributes the latency excess across preregistered scaffolding phases with a closure gate, (c) exhibits the honest scaffolding-inclusive 5-field sensitivity, (d) delivers the B11 probe-coverage certificate as the second mandated deliverable, and (e) terminates under the mandate stop trigger: SUPPORTS re-admits localized repair to the C-PRODUCT-ECON story with honest denominators; any valid deficit permanently drops it with no further L-sweeps. No existing packet provides the attribution, the certificate, or the terminating rule; the priced comparison itself is continuity (same substrate/carrier/classes/seeds), not a rerun of an equal-weight-only design loop.
falsifier: The mandate's re-admission claim FAILS (no re-admit; permanent bounded drop from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story) if, with H1 functional/locality gates and the V-EQ shipped-counter reproduction premise holding on every class, EITHER the shipped 4-field reuse-vs-cold comparison is >= 1.00 at L=2 OR at L=3, OR the median episode-latency ratio is >= 1.00 at L=2 or L=3 under the v4 inclusive timed boundary - i.e. the SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED split persists after scaffolding attribution and the mandate stop trigger converts it to permanent drop. It FAILS differently (FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL, bounded mechanism concern, still no re-admit) if functional/locality soundness itself breaks. It FAILS to decide (MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE, never falsification, no drop) on any insensitive control, broken reproduction premise, attribution-closure failure affecting the priced surfaces, pin/freeze mismatch, or construction failure. The attribution sub-question resolves to UNATTRIBUTED (honest unknown) rather than falsified if no single component reaches the 0.50 share on >=2 classes with closure holding.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Denominator fixed in advance to B-COLD/B-COLD-MIN (same-carrier cold re-derivation at L=3/L=2); never the abstention control, never a single ratio. Treatment shares carrier/substrate/seeds/perturbations/target-rotation with baselines and differs only in physical resolve/fetch/verify/scaffold counts, evidenced by per-operation logs plus per-phase timings plus scaffold counts (V14). Conservative/legacy arms are reported sensitivities excluded from the classifier (legacy only as V13 replication premise). No counter is tuned: shipped 4-field uses preregistered unit weights; scaffold units are preregistered 1:1 counts; the 5-field sensitivity is informational and excluded from the classifier; latency is raw perf_counter.

control_sensitivity.reason: Distinct non-tautological controls per failure mode, all inherited live from the parent PASS packet on the identical substrate/carrier and re-verified at DESIGN: PC-BASE-LIVENESS scored in-trial; B-LITERAL-REPLAY/B-NO-REPAIR must-fail; NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE must-silent; NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR live (parent 4/4 every trial; DESIGN smoke confirms instrument path executes). New gates: V0 substrate pin (v2 hash+bytes re-verified at DESIGN), V-EQ shipped-counter reproduction premise (deterministic integer counter; break signals drift, not a negative), V-TIMING (2 warmups/trial, exact 6/6 parity per class, finite timings), V-CLOSURE (attribution-track only), V-CERT (certificate-track only). No control is given the treatment answer; certificate ground truth (perturbed=stale) is fixed before the guard runs.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The frozen pure classifier was driven with synthetic rows at DESIGN (non-substrate, non-outcome-bearing): all 4 class branches {PRICED-WIN, PRICED-DEFICIT, FUNCTIONAL-FAIL, COST-UNKNOWN} and all 4 aggregates {SUPPORTS, PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED, FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL, INCONCLUSIVE} produced (all True). The 5-field scaffold-inclusive sensitivity was DELIBERATELY excluded from the classifier after DESIGN arithmetic proved its reuse deficit deterministic (nominal 27-28 vs 21-22 units): including it would make SUPPORTS arithmetically unreachable, a degenerate design; it is reported as diagnostics instead. The live decider is latency lw (parent P2-L3 CI95 lower bound 1.0022 shows genuine flippability) under the v4 inclusive boundary, with the v3-exact boundary (S-ARG excluded) as sensitivity. No bar sits at/below a structural floor: all bars are strict inequalities on live quantities; success-rate 1.0 ceilings are functional gates, not deciders.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Every mutable local code dependency whose identity can change the interpretation is listed and hashed at freeze: src/spider/kernel.py (counter/treatment semantics) 3a6caf97..., src/spider/models.py 338aaf4d..., src/spider/registry.py 51fb440d... (all re-verified byte-identical to the parent freeze at DESIGN). The executable v4 driver is embedded verbatim in prereg.md section-12 and bound by CANONICAL-RUNNER-V4-SHA256 plus freeze hashes. Parent v2/v3 runners are IMMUTABLE references (hash+size pinned, V0 gate refuses on mismatch), not mutable artifacts. No external task bank/dataset/fixture is read (substrate, perturbation bank, certificate bank all built in-runner; certificate bank = the frozen scored-trial set + NCs). List complete.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All hard prerequisites verified at DESIGN without confirmatory measurement: Python 3.12 stdlib; carrier imports and executes (hashes match parent freeze); DESIGN pin check (v2 60855 bytes d487... verified, module import works); DESIGN instrumentation smoke (single discarded N=1 trial: phase timers execute, registry-IO vs guard-compute asymmetry measurable, closure computable); timer resolution 1ns; perturbation bank enumerable from pinned v2 (3 LOCAL classes, rotating targets, fixed seed scheme). No external bank/dataset/fixture/model endpoint needed. B3 model endpoint absent by construction (structural zeros preregistered, blocker recorded). Nothing assumed.

treatment_liveness.reason: Treatment uses the shipped carrier that parent packets executed end-to-end (distill_parameterized -> resolve EXECUTABLE -> fetch 200 -> verify True; repair-signal path produces patches; DESIGN smoke re-executed the path). The v4 runner calls the same pinned v2 arm functions with added non-semantic instrumentation (timers/counters); instrumentation adds no new failure mode to the treatment path (wrapping only). Success rates at the 1.0 ceiling are functional gates, not the measured advantage: cost dynamic range is live (nominal 17 vs 18/19) and latency adds a continuous surface. No structural barrier to EXECUTABLE.

hypothesis: H1 (functional/locality gates, re-attested): after a single LOCAL perturbation, reuse-based signal-driven local repair restores success on ALL FIVE TASK_IDS at rate >= 0.80 per class (Wilson lower >= 0.60), guard fires >= 0.80, write_set_max <= 1, same-target contamination <= 0.10, overbroad control fires > 0.10. H2 (shipped counter): under the mandate's shipped 4-field unit counter (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, unit weights, zero fitted quantities), reuse product is STRICTLY below cold at BOTH L=2 and L=3 on all classes (V-EQ reproduction premise). H3 (end-to-end latency): median timed-episode latency ratio reuse/cold is STRICTLY below 1.00 at BOTH L=2 and L=3 under the v4 inclusive timed boundary. H4 (attribution): the reuse latency excess (if any) is attributable to preregistered scaffolding phases (S-REGISTRY-BUILD/SCAN/WRITE, S-GUARD, S-REPAIR-SIGNAL, S-ARG, S-EXECUTE, S-DISTILL) with phase-closure |S-MISC|/episode median <= 0.20 per class; the top component covers >= 0.50 of the median episode gap on >= 2/3 classes. H5 (B3): model_calls/model_tokens are structurally 0 (no LLM endpoint on substrate); real model-call/token economics is UNSATISFIABLE here, priced in counters only, blocker recorded. H6 (certificate): the guard probe-coverage certificate over the frozen 36-trial bank + NCs is complete (V-CERT): sensitivity/specificity measured, false-accept count exact, residual budget-sparse boundary explicitly enumerated with measured-vs-derived labels. H7 (replication premise): T-REPAIR-LEGACY still reproduces the prior regression (shipped ratio > 1.00 at L=2).
measurement_validity: V0-SUBSTRATE-PIN: the immutable parent v2 runner file must hash to d4871091dc5bf9aa21d918f2577612aa8c5762e314033d0bbbee46b4962bc608 (60855 bytes) before import; mismatch aborts (refuse-to-run), never a result.
V1-FREEZE_BINDING: the v4 driver extracted by splitting prereg.md section-12 markers hashes to CANONICAL-RUNNER-V4-SHA256; request/spec/prereg/carrier hashes match freeze.json.

V2-SUBSTRATE_ISOLATION: Python 3.12 stdlib only (ThreadingHTTPServer, localhost ephemeral port); no LLM, credential, external network, browser; therefore model_calls/model_tokens are structurally 0 and fetches are the scarce accounting resource.

V3-DETERMINISM-PROJECTION: fixed seeds (SEED4=3980394806; per-trial seeds derived as SEED4+1000*(ci+1)+j; bootstrap seeds derived); the discrete/counter projection (success, counters, oplogs, order flags, validity flags, scaffold counts, phase timings) is recorded for audit recomputation; latency is wall-clock and NOT projected as deterministic.
V4-PERTURBATION_BITES: B-LITERAL-REPLAY success <= 0.10 every class.
V5-COLD_BASELINE_LIVE: B-COLD success >= 0.90 every class.
V6-NO_REPAIR_INERT: B-NO-REPAIR success <= 0.10; never a denominator.
V7-GUARD_LIVENESS: guard fires >= 0.80 on perturbed trials AND NOT on NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE.
V8-NO_TARGET_LEAKAGE: repair writes exactly one mechanism (write_set_max <= 1); contamination measured only on genuinely unaffected resources with the in-support probe (id=14).

V9-INTEGER_COUNTERS: cost counters are integer counts from the shipped TrajectoryCounters surface plus preregistered integer scaffold units; latency is perf_counter seconds; no estimated, fitted, or model-token quantities.

V10-THRESHOLD_NOT_FITTED: all bars, bootstrap B_LAT=2000, N=12, scaffold unit definitions/parity, phase list, and attribution thresholds were preregistered before any scored run; NO calibration workload exists in v4 (the parent Stage-A fitter is deliberately removed: unit weights need no fitting); the 5-field sensitivity weight (1:1 parity) is preregistered and informational only.
V11-N_CONTROLLED: TRIALS_PER_CLASS=12 with rotating targets; 2 warmups per trial excluded; certificate bank = the exact 36 scored perturbations + NC probes.
V12-POSITIVE_CONTROL: PC-BASE-LIVENESS true inside EVERY valid scored trial.
V13-LEGACY_REPRODUCTION: T-REPAIR-LEGACY shipped ratio > 1.00 at L=2; failure is a reported validity caveat (diagnostic premise, not a gate).

V14-REUSE_IDENTITY: treatment, conservative, legacy share seeds/perturbations/substrate/baseline with the cold arms in-trial; per-operation logs plus per-phase timings differ only in preregistered scaffolding; oplogs present every trial.
V15-CONTAMINATION-INSTRUMENT-LIVE: probes total > 0 AND overbroad rate > 0.10; else MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

V-EQ-REPRODUCTION_PREMISE: shipped 4-field equal premise eq holds (reuse<cold at L2 AND L3, fetch_L3<=0.90) on every class; break signals substrate/carrier drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never a negative).

V-TIMING: 2 warmups per trial (72 total); per-class parity order exactly 6 rep-first/6 cold-first; zero timed-episode errors; all episode latencies finite > 0; v4 inclusive boundary (arg deepcopy inside timing, symmetric) primary with v3-exact boundary (S-ARG excluded) as sensitivity.
V-CLOSURE (attribution track only): median |S-MISC|/episode <= 0.20 per class; failure invalidates only the attribution answer (UNATTRIBUTED/ATTRIBUTION-INVALID), never the priced decision.

V-CERT (certificate track only): bank fully enumerated pre-run; every bank item scored exactly once with guard verdict + ground truth recorded; residual boundary enumerated with measured-vs-derived labels; failure invalidates only the certificate deliverable, never the priced decision.

Representation loss: simplified JSON API, not real websites; conclusions bounded to this substrate/carrier/classes/counters; model-call economics unmeasured by construction (B3 UNSATISFIABLE, carried as blocked-unknown); bytes reported diagnostic only.

Scope bound: does not execute the gated C-PRODUCT-ECON flagship; mutates no cross-lane claim status; produces terminal decision inputs for the Runtime DIRECTOR and Global Research Director; certificate schema co-owned with product for B11.

null_control.failure_policy: Any false-firing guard -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Insensitive overbroad -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the parent F1 failure must not recur). Broken V-EQ reproduction -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (drift, never a scientific negative). V-CLOSURE failure -> attribution INVALID only. V-CERT failure -> certificate INVALID only.
null_control.protocol: NC-NO-PERTURBATION: guard on unperturbed body must be fresh (stale=false). NC-NOISE: observed_at churn must not fire. NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR: target repaired postconditions applied to ALL mechanisms; in-support probe on 4 unaffected resources must flag breakage (>0.10). V-CLOSURE: sum of preregistered phase timings must reconstruct each timed episode within 20% (median per class). V-CERT: certificate bank fully enumerated and singly scored with ground truth.
null_control.success_criterion: NC-NO-PERTURBATION stale=false AND NC-NOISE stale=false; overbroad rate > 0.10 with probes>0; closure medians <= 0.20; certificate bank complete.

members.protocol: Inside every scored trial: boot substrate, distill from LEARN_IDS via shipped distill_parameterized, then for each of five resources resolve+fetch+verify in-support probe id 14 against the live server BEFORE perturbation.
members.success_criterion: all five return (200, id, verified=True); base_liveness=true for the trial.

members.protocol: Non-outcome-bearing DESIGN probes: v2 pin + carrier-hash verification, module import, single discarded N=1 instrumentation smoke (phase timers execute, registry-IO vs guard-compute asymmetry measurable), timer check, synthetic classifier reachability.
members.success_criterion: server path importable, pin verified, carrier hashes match parent freeze, timer 1ns, smoke executes with finite phases, all 4+4 classifier branches reachable.

positive_control.success_criterion: pre-perturbation, in EVERY scored trial, all five learned mechanisms resolve EXECUTABLE and verify on the in-support probe (base_liveness=true); aggregate true-trials == total. Attestation inside the scored artifact.

product_consequence_negative: Any valid non-win (PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED: shipped counter deficit or latency deficit at L=2 or L=3 on any class; FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL: broken functional/locality soundness) PERMANENTLY DROPS reuse-based localized repair from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story on this substrate/carrier/classes/counter, with no further L-sweeps (mandate stop trigger fires here, resolving the parent AF-7 ambiguity for this packet: this negative IS a permanent drop, unlike the parent's drop-pending ruling). C-DELTA-REPAIR itself is NOT rejected and stays EXPERIMENTAL bounded to functional/locality soundness (repair works; it just does not pay end-to-end). No promotion. The B3 blocker (no model economics) and the certificate boundary are carried as explicit unknowns, not as drop rationale.
product_consequence_positive: SUPPORTS (shipped 4-field reuse strictly cheaper at L=2 AND L=3 AND median latency strictly below cold at L=2 AND L=3, all classes, valid gates) RE-ADMITS reuse-based localized repair to the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story WITH honest denominators (shipped unit counter + inclusive-boundary latency + scaffold attribution + B11 certificate). No code promotion (runtime lane; no kernel change; carrier byte-identical). B3 real model-call/token economics remains an explicit recorded blocker for any flagship product-economics claim.
question: Which uncounted episode-scaffolding component accounts for the ~0.2-0.9ms reuse latency excess, and under a shipped scaffolding-priced end-to-end counter (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, plus a measured probe-coverage certificate or runtime observation guard for the B11 budget-sparse boundary as the second deliverable), is reuse-based localized repair strictly cheaper than cold re-derivation at L=2 and L=3 - i.e. does the SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED split resolve toward re-admission or permanent drop from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story? (B3 model economics unsatisfiable here: priced in counters only, blocker recorded.)
title: Scaffolding-attributed, scaffolding-priced terminal comparison for delta-repair with B11 certificate
